title: Direct Selling
description: Definition of Direct Selling under the Consumer Protection Act, 2019

content.legal_definition: marketing, distribution and sale of goods or provision of services through a network of sellers, other than through a permanent retail location
content.plain_language: Selling products or services directly to customers through a network of sellers, without using a fixed store
examples: A company selling cosmetics through independent distributors
A network of individuals selling kitchen utensils door-to-door
non_examples: A retail store selling products from a fixed location
A company selling products only through its website

user_queries: Is direct selling legal in India
